name: Smoke Detector
summary: Detects smoke and sounds an alarm to alert occupants.
education: Modern smoke detectors are typically replaced every 10 years because the sensor element degrades. Most have a manufacture date stamped on the back. Battery-only, hardwired, and combination smoke/CO units all need regular testing.

maintenance.why: Confirms the horn and sensor are working — a dead detector is silent during a fire.

maintenance.cadence_text: Once a year (or when it chirps)
maintenance.why: Even battery backups in hardwired units fail without notice.
The sensor element loses sensitivity even if the alarm still chirps.
